example.title: Lifeguard tower 10, Sunset Beach
example.place: Sunset Beach (Huntington Beach), Orange County, CA

brief: An Orange County beach lifeguard tower of the type used at Sunset Beach and Huntington Beach since the 1990s-2000s: a square cabin painted cream with a big black tower number on the sea face, a flared overhanging pyramid roof with a dark fascia, a wraparound railed deck on four splayed dark-brown timber legs, and a ramp and ladder down to the sand. The cabin carries a posted 'NO LIFEGUARD ON DUTY' board. It stands on sand, on the pier's approach. One photo; the year is estimated. Legs piled 10 m into the sand (spec rule 4).
